providers.policy_note: Documented unauthenticated public Exchange products/ticker endpoints; read-only bounded personal research. Retain only selected public numeric fields, dates and hashes, not a redistributable full market dataset. Directory identity and official ticker field definitions are checked.

Documented public market-data APIs, no account or authentication; bounded GET for personal research. Retain selected numeric fields and hashes only. Check active mainnet inverse USD BTC-settled perpetual identity; funding_8h is a fraction and open_interest is USD notional for this contract, not all-market leverage.

Public publisher page and linked Bitcoin ETF flow table; respect robots, no login, redirect or access-limit bypass. Copyright remains with Farside Investors. Retain one latest dated table row, column definitions and hashes for attributed personal research; no whole HTML/table archive or systematic dataset redistribution. Provider itself warns of errors/inaccuracies. AUM/product structure are not daily net flows; no complete regulator/issuer daily aggregate was verified.

Check public HTTP robots access only; do not bypass disallow, authenticate, collect user profiles or retain post content. This MVP has no authorized Reddit content contract. A permitted access check would still not promote posts without a reviewed parser and access/retention policy.

providers.query: bitcoin price; comment; chronological public search; screen for investment relevance
providers.policy_note: Documented public Algolia HN search and original HN item API; search responses are discovery references only. Open actual item and verify identity, publication, text and live/not-deleted state. Retain at most two bounded relevant text excerpts with attribution/permalink and hashes; no author/profile/contact/like data or full response retention. Purpose sample is not representative market sentiment.
